name: Recover a Deleted File
problem: You deleted a file, or completely ruined its contents, and need to get the original version back from Git.

steps.title: Recover uncommitted deletion
steps.description: If you deleted the file but haven't committed the deletion yet, you can simply restore it from the last commit.
steps.code:
git restore path/to/deleted-file.js

# Or in older Git versions:
git checkout HEAD -- path/to/deleted-file.js

steps.title: Recover staged deletion
steps.description: If you ran `git rm` or `git add` and the deletion is staged, you must unstage it first, then restore.
steps.code:
git restore --staged path/to/deleted-file.js
git restore path/to/deleted-file.js

steps.title: Recover committed deletion
steps.description: If you already committed the deletion, you need to find the commit where the file still existed, and check it out from there.
steps.code:
# 1. Find the last commit that touched the file
git log --all -- path/to/deleted-file.js

# 2. Look at the commit BEFORE the deletion (e.g., HEAD~1 or a specific hash)
# 3. Checkout the file from that past commit
git checkout a1b2c3d^ -- path/to/deleted-file.js

# 4. Commit the restored file
git commit -m "Restore accidentally deleted file"
